NONE MAY STAND AGAINST THE CHILDREN OF EXO!|audio = FailedGatewayWave15-3-4.ogg|[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] on Wave 15 ([[Failed Gateway]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Titus''', also referred to as '''Maximus''' in cutscenes, was the final boss of [[Failed Gateway]], the first night of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a fairly fast speed when compared to other bosses. It had two abilities. The first was ''Void Stream'', where '''Titus''' would windup and attack several towers in proximity. This would apply a 60% [[Firerate Debuff]] (150% increase) to them and regenerate its own health by 15 for each tower attacked at rapid speed. Its second ability, ''Dark Decoy'', made it summon five [[Neuro Runner]]s and five [[Bloated]] [[Brain Bound]]s, all with a 0.2 second delay between each spawn. Additionally, '''Titus''' itself would temporarily gain the [[Aggro]] and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attributes, while also gaining a permanent 5% defense increase. ==Appearance== '''Titus''' had tan skin, with a part of its face being purple. Its right arm was replaced with a mechanical arm, which had three claws and a laser blaster in it. It had blond hair. It wore a khaki shirt and blue pants, alongside brown shoes. On its left arm, it had a metal shoulder-pad, multiple brown bandages, brown glove and black brass knuckles with spikes. It also wore a purple bandanna. On its torso, it had a large brown belt connected to a brown armor piece, which protected part of its mechanical arm that was connected to the torso. It had a brown belt with pouches and a grey plate with "''4OBIA''" written on it. It also had grey knee-pads. ==Strategy== *Due to the low amount of waves to prepare, it is recommended to use more cost effective towers against '''Titus''', such as the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Militant]] or [[Engineer]]. **In Easy mode, '''Titus''' has a lot less health, so it should not be a big issue. The DPS options that the preset loadouts contain should take care of it easily. *You may bring support towers such as the [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] to help boost your towers. *[[Military Base]] is also a good option against '''Titus''', due to the high health [[units]] dealing lots of collision damage. The high health units are also a great counter for ''Dark Decoy'', as the units will buffer the enemies spawned in, helping reduce the effectiveness of the [[Aggro]] modifier. *It is recommended to place a few towers as distraction so that '''Titus''' uses ''Void Stream'' on them instead of your DPS towers. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:TitusVampirism.ogg]] |When '''Titus''' performs ''Void Stream'' ability |- |[[File:TitusSummon.ogg]] |When '''Titus''' performs ''Dark Decoy'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:TitusDeath.ogg]] |When '''Titus''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HexscapeEventCountdownIcon.png|'''Titus''' on the game icon. ChildrenofExoMembers.png|'''Titus''' on the Children of Exo member list. }} ==Trivia== *'''Titus''' is the name of a [[wp:Epistle to Titus|epistle in the New Testament]], as well as the name of a [[wp:Titus|Roman Emperor]]. **Titus was one of the most common names in Ancient Rome. *'''Titus''' was referred to as Maximus in [[Failed Gateway]]'s beginning cutscene. As for some of the audio files, it is referred to as Titus Maximushttps://create.roblox.com/store/asset/125401119711391/AudioTitus-Maximus-Laser-Attack-Thingy-1, it is highly likely it is either its last name or some form of a secondary title. *The belt '''Titus''' wears has the nameplate "''4OBIA''", which is a wordplay on the word "''phobia''". *The voice actor of '''Titus''' is [https://youtube.com/@enthrallist_?si=mjsg6lUOnuGaMRk4 Enthrallist], who also works as a composer for Tower Defense Simulator. *'''Titus''' had a cash/health ratio of 5 to 1 in Hard difficulty and 13.33 to 1 in Easy, the highest in the game. **For context, '''Titus''' had 40,000 health in Hard and 15,000 in Easy and gave {{Money|200,000}} total. ==Update History== *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Titus''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense. **{{Bug}} '''Titus''' receives damage at rapid speed from unit collision, if the damage dealt is to its healed health. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Titus''' can no longer have its defense decreased. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense if it is not a [[Boss]] enemy, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Titus''' removed. ==Notes== {{FailedGateway|[[Synaptic]]|Wave 10|Titus|Wave 15|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
